Commentary.Commentary: So, 341 to get off the 50 overs. England are in the driver's seat at this moment. Pakistan's bowling has been lacklustre in this series so far and Sarfaraz will be hoping that changes tonight. The second innings is not far away. Join us for it.

As for England's bowling, Tom Curran was the star. Though he gave away 75 runs off his 10, he got a 4-fer and restricted Pakistan under 350. Archer and Wood also got into the wickets column with 1 and 2 respectively. In all, 7 bowlers were used by the English. They will be happy with their efforts overall as they gave away just 42 runs in the last 5 overs and have managed to restrict the tourists to a below par total on this batting paradise.

After winning the toss, England put the visitors to bat first. The innings did not get off to a good start for the Asian side as they lost Imam-ul-Haq due to an injury. Babar replaced him out in the middle. He had a brilliant partnership with Fakhar and the two added 107 with both getting to their respective fifties. Fakhar Zaman could not carry for long after and was dismissed but Babar carried on. Him and Hafeez stitched together a 104-run stand. Babar went on to convert his start to a big one and got his 9th ODI hundred. Cameos from Sarfaraz Ahmed and Shoaib Malik in the end propelled them to 340.

14 runs off the last over have seen Pakistan reach 340 from their final over but one would feel England would be the happier side going into the break. Normally, 340 is a good total but these days nothing less than 375 looks safe.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! The skipper finishes the innings with a boundary. Fuller on off, Sarfaraz lofts it over mid off. Roy runs in from long on and puts in a dive to stop the ball. He gets there but cannot collect it cleanly. The ball goes past him for a boundary. Pakistan end with 340/7 from their 50 overs.
Length ball outside off, Imam looks uncomfortable but gets a single by running it down to third man.
Length ball on the body, SA plays it towards mid off and gets a run.
FOUR! This is even better. Length ball outside off, Sarfaraz smashes it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on off, Sarfaraz upper cuts it towards backward point for a boundary. Pakistan need more of this.
Brilliant start. Yorker on the leg side, Sarfaraz looks to jam it out but misses.
Another bouncer to end the over. Just 4 runs off the over. Brilliant. Jofra finishes with the figures of 10-0-62-1.
Bouncer. Right on the money. Imam ducks under it and lets it carry to the keeper.
WIDE! Jofra misses his line and length and bowls it down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Length ball on off, Sarfaraz flat bats it past Jofra. Ben Stokes runs to his right from mid off and stops the ball with a dive. Not the most convincing dives though. They take just a run.
Full on middle and leg, Imam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
STAT ALERT - This is the second time that Shoaib Malik has been dismissed hit wicket in ODIs - THE 8TH PLAYER TO SUFFER THIS FATE!
Excellent bouncer. Playing with the mind of Imam. It is on the body, Imam ducks under it.
Fuller on off, Sarfaraz lofts it over covers. The ball falls short of the fielder in the deep and they get a single.
On the pads, Sarfaraz flicks it to mid-wicket for a run. Tremendous over from Curran. Just 4 runs and a wicket.
Outside off, Imad defends it towards short third man for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Imam blocks it. Maybe his elbow is not yet fully recovered.
On the pads, Safaraz looks to flick but misses. It goes off the pads and they take a leg bye.
Surprising! Imam-ul-Haq has come out to bat with his left elbow nicely wrapped.

OUT! Hasan Ali holes out. The slower one does the trick for Curran and he gets his fourth wicket of the match. He has had a good day with the ball. It is slow on full, Hasan looks to go over mid-wicket fence but he does not time it well. Joe Denly takes a good catch in the deep.
Full and outside off, Sarfaraz looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point. A single taken.
Tom Curran is back.
Full on off, Sarfaraz drives it wide of mid off and keeps the strike.
Full on off, Ali hits it wide of mid off and gets off the mark straightaway.
Hasan Ali is the new batsman.

OUT! HIT WICKET! A funny dismissal to say the least. Length ball just outside off, Malik was deep inside his crease as he was expecting a yorker but it was a length ball. He looks to slap it down the off side but ends up taking off his stumps with his bat. He will be reminded about this dismissal for a long time to come now.
Length ball outside off, Malik cuts it wide of deep point for a couple.
Smart batting, this. Wood follows Malik who was making room by moving away from the leg stump. He bowls it on his body and Shoaib strokes it towards backward point for a couple.
FOUR! On the leg side now. Shoaib showing why Pakistan have him in their World Cup squad. Length ball on middle and leg, Shoaib whacks his pull between deep mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.
Mark Wood is back on.

Quick single taken. Good running. On off, Shoaib strokes it towards mid off. Jofra runs behind it and has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and they get the single easily in the end. 10 from this over!
WIDE! Attempted bouncer from Jofra goes over the head of Malik. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Shoaib gives himself room and smacks this slower delivery over point for a boundary. Cannot offer too much width to this experienced campaigner.
Length ball on off, Sarfaraz moves away and then runs it down to third man for a run.
300 up for Pakistan. On the pads, Sarfaraz flicks it wide of fine leg and gets a couple. They will look to get another 50 runs minimum.
Makes room to a length ball around off but drives it straight to mid off.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side for a run.
Sarfaraz Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em. End of an eventful over. Good length ball on middle, Imad was looking to go too hard at Curran, he misses his shot and Curran hits. The stumps are disturbed and Tom Curran is a happy man. Imad's cameo comes to an end.
WIDE! Bouncer gone wrong again. It is over the bowler's head and it has been signalled as wide.
FOUR! Slashed and slashed hard. It is on a length outside off, Imad slams it over covers for a boundary.
Good comeback from Curran. He bowls a good pacy yorker on middle, Imad cannot do much but just jam it out.
SIX! Slower bouncer gone wrong. Tom rolls his finger on it and bowls it short, Imad flat-bats it over the bowler's head. His bottom hand came off the bat but still he managed to clear the rope.
Play and a miss. Length ball on off and middle, Wasim looks to pull it but misses.
Very good ball from Tom. Bowls it slow and wide outside off to Imad. He had cleared his front leg out of the way early so he ended up leaving it alone.
Tom Curran is back for another go.
Full on the pads, Malik flicks it wide of deep square leg for a couple.
Physio has come out in the middle. Imad Wasim is looking a bit rattled. Takes his helmet off and is trying to catch some breath.

Brilliant bouncer. It is right on the money. His short ball did the damage earlier in the day to Imam but luckily Imad's blow is not as nasty as Imam's one. He looks to pull it but misses. The ball hits him on his helmet and goes towards third man for a leg bye.
Back of a length ball on the leg side, Shoaib was moving away and hence Wood smartly followed him. Shoaib still manages to cut it behind point for a run.
Slower delivery shorter in length, Imad looks to hit it on the off side but gets it off the lower half of his bat towards cover for a single.
Full toss on middle, Malik was looking to flick it but gets a leading edge which goes towards point for a single. He would be kicking himself for missing out on a juicy full toss.
On off, Wasim drives it towards cover and gets a single.

Imad Wasim is the new batsman. He is ready to take strike but there is no non-striker there. Shoaib Malik has gone to the pavilion, probably to attend the nature's call. He returns after a while. A bowling change also. Mark Wood to bowl...

OUT! Tremendous catch from Mark Wood! Jofra gets the better of Asif. Jofra bangs it in short and Ali looks to pull but ends up top edging it. The ball goes high in the air but does not get the desired distance. It goes to the left of Mark Wood at deep backward square leg. He keeps his eyes on the ball and takes an excellent catch diving full length. The breeze was not helping his cause but as he kept his eyes on the ball he was able to catch it. A good lesson for any youngster watching it. Wood is absolutely delighted and he flicks the ball back in celebration. Big blow to Pakistan as Asif is known to be a fine hitter in the death overs.
FOUR! Now he connects and gets a boundary. Length ball outside off, Asif drives it through covers for a boundary.
Smart, smart bowling this. This is the reason he is a man in demand. After two slower balls, Jofra bowls a pacy yorker outside off, Ali misses to hit it once again.
Two in a row now. Another slower delivery outside off, Asif once again frees his arm but misses.
Nice change of pace there. It is outside off and slower, Asif swings his bat but misses.
Full outside off, Shoaib hits it towards long on and gets a single.
On the pads, Malik works it down to long on and keeps strike for the next over. 8 from the over without the batters taking any risks.
Slows it up and lands it around off. Ali dances down the track and looks to go big but it goes off the inner half towards long on for one.
Lovely placement! Ali works it between long on and mid-wicket and takes an easy two.
Another slider and on the pads, it is flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on the pads, it is pushed towards mid on gently. The batsmen take two. Good running.
Ali brings out the slog sweep but it goes off the inner half through square leg for one.
Adil Rashid is back on now!
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Back of a length ball outside off, Malik slashes it over and wide of point fielder for a boundary. 15 runs off the over.
Good length ball outside off, Shoaib cuts it wide of deep point and gets a couple.
On middle, Asif strokes it to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! Good running but also great football skills shown by Archer. Good length ball on off, Malik looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Asif calls for a quick single, Archer goes to the ball and hits the stumps by kicking the ball. They go upstairs and the replays show Ali was in.
A run out appeal has been taken upstairs! Asif Ali is the man in question. No one seems excited though.
This time Ali hits it to the man there at long on, all along the ground, for a single.

SIX! Asif Ali is wasting no time here. Full on middle and leg, it is in the slot for Asif. He smokes it over long on. The fielder there was interested for a bit but in the end can just watch it sail over the fence.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Jofra Archer is on.
On the pads, Malik flicks it wide of the man at deep square leg and gets a couple.
Shorter on the body, Asif plays an awkward looking pull towards mid-wicket for a run. He is off the mark.
Asif Ali comes out next to bat.

OUT! Curran has the last laugh and an excellent innings from Babar comes to an end. Tom bowls it on a length outside off, taking some pace off it. Babar looks to punch it off the back foot but is early into his shot. It goes uppishly towards deep cover. For a moment, it looked like it will fall short of Archer but Jofra dives in front and takes a good catch. Babar walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd.
Just in - Imam-ul-Haq has returned from the hospital after his X-ray. It's all fine, no fracture and there is just swelling at the moment. His left elbow is all wrapped up, probably some ice applied.
FOUR! That went like a tracer bullet. Short outside off, Azam gets the width he likes and slashes his cut through point for a boundary.
On off, Azam blocks it off the front foot.

Slower delivery, really full on off, Shoaib flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket. They run the first one hard and get the second one. Buttler does not gather the throw properly allowing them to take an extra run. Three taken in total. Poor from England. There have been some pretty average stuff in the field from them today.
This time cuts it off the middle but straight to point.

FOUR! Now from an edge. This is a cruel game for the bowlers. Nothing wrong in the delivery. It is on a length outside off, Azam looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge which goes flying through the third man region for a boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full on middle and leg. It is a half volley given as a gift from Mark to Babar. He takes it with both hands and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Slower delivery on a length outside off, Malik taps it down to third man and rotates the strike.
Full on the pads, Shoaib flicks it to square leg for a run.
Outside off, BA punches it to the off side for a run.
Outside off on a length, Shoaib hits it to the man at point. 12 from the over!
WIDE! Curran misses his line and length and sprays it down the leg side. Malik looks to flick but misses. Wide signalled.
Now a single towards deep cover.

FOUR! 100 FOR BABAR AZAM! What a fine knock this has been from him. He came in after Imam got injured but he has looked absolutely amazing. On the pads, Babar flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary to get to his 9th ODI hundred. He takes his helmet off and raises his bat and soaks in the applause from the crowd.
Full on the pads, Malik flicks it away to deep square leg and gets a single to follow up the boundary.
FOUR! What a shot! Length ball outside off, Malik slashes it over point for a boundary. Good way to get off the mark.
On the body, Babar tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single. Moves to 97.
Tom Curran is back into the attack.
Goes very full and on off, Malik jams it out. End of a top over by Wood, just the three runs and a wicket from it.
Back of a length again on off, Malik blocks it out.
Shoaib Malik is the new man in.

OUT! Now a wicket! Hafeez departs soon after getting to a half ton. The short ball does the trick for Wood. Timely wicket for England as Hafeez was just looking to step on the gas. It is the bumper and it is outside off. Hafeez looks to drag his pull but due to the pace, he is a touch late into the shot. Ends up hitting it a lot straighter than he would have wanted. It goes straight into the hands of Jordan the substitute at mid on. England are ecstatic after breaking the 104-run stand.
Very full on middle, this is jammed out to mid on for a run. Three singles in the first three balls in this over.
Slower ball on off, Hafeez eases it through covers for another single.
On the shorter side, it is slapped through covers for one.
Floated on the stumps, Azam comes down the track and strokes it to long on to keep the strike.
Shorter outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes towards backward point for a run. 100-run stand comes up!
On the pads, Azam flicks it down to square leg for a run.
Now follows it up with a single down to fine leg for a run.
SIX! Just over. Shorter on middle and off, Hafeez rocks onto his back foot and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Moeen bowls it flatter on middle, Babar comes down the track and pushes it wide of the bowler to long off for a run.

Drinks Break. Pakistan are going strong at the moment but will now look to up the run rate. Mohammad Hafeez and Babar Azam both are set in the middle with the former reaching his fifty just before the break, while the latter looks on course to get to a ton. They are going just under 6 at the moment but should aim to get close to 350 on this wonderful batting track. England need a wicket here to break the partnership and put pressure on the visitors.
A dot to end! Back of a length on off, Hafeez keeps it out.

FOUR! That has been nailed! What a way to get to your fifty. His 37th in ODIs. A very good comeback game from him. Hafeez creams this length ball through point and it races away. Raises his bat, Professor. Can he make it big now? Pakistan would hope he does and that too at a better rate.
A crisp drive through the covers, straight to the man at sweeper though and it is only a single.
Gets his line right and lands it on off, the length is similar. Pushed to mid off.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batter, it is clipped through mid-wicket for one.
Starts off with a very straight delivery, it is worked through square leg for one. Into the 90s is Azam, also the 200 is up for Pakistan.
Mark Wood is back!

Missed stumping. Floated on leg, Hafeez comes down the track but misses it. The ball goes through him to the keeper. Buttler does not collect it and it hits him and goes to short fine leg. The skipper is gutted with himself and rightfully so. Moeen should have had his man there.
Flatter on off, Hafeez taps it to point.
SIX! Right on the ropes. Tossed up on off, Hafeez comes down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head. The ball hits the rope and the replays confirm it. Six signalled.
Tossed up on middle and off, BA comes down the track and plays it to long on for a run.
Flighted on middle, Hafeez plays it to the man  at long on and gets a single.
Play and a miss. Flatter outside off, MH looks to cut but misses. The ball just goes over the outside edge.
Fuller on off, Azam strokes it to the man at cover. 5 off this one.
Length ball on off, BA pushes it to mid off.
Outside off on a length, Hafeez runs it down to point for a run.
Dot now. Length ball outside off, Hafeez plays it to the man at point.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Hafeez drives it elegantly through covers. The fielder in the deep puts in a dive but cannot stop it from going to the ropes.
Back of a length ball on off, Hafeez flat-bats it towards the bowler.
On the pads, Hafeez glances it to fine leg and keeps the strike.
On the pads, Babar flicks it to the leg side for a run.
In the air but safe. Flighted on off, Hafeez comes down the track and uppishly pushes it between extra cover and the bowler. The ball goes to long off and they take a run.
Tossed up outside off, Babar hits it on the off side for a run.
Full on off, BA tucks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Shorter on middle, Hafeez cuts it to deep point for a run.
Play and a miss to end the over. Slower delivery outside off, Azam looks to cut it but misses.
Peach of a delivery. Jofra extracts extra bounce. It is outside off, Azam looks to drive but misses. The ball just about misses the outside edge on its way to the keeper.
Outside off, Hafeez easily drives it to deep cover and takes a run.
Good length ball on off, Hafeez gets on his back foot and blocks it.
Outside off, Azam strokes it to covers and gets to the other end.
Jofra starts his new spell with a slower delivery. It is full on middle, Hafeez flicks it away to deep square leg and gets a run.
Jofra Archer is back on.
Leans forward to a full ball on middle and pushes it down to mid on. Dot ball to end the over, 6 from it.
Helps a full ball through mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a single.
Advances down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.

A mistimed shot in the air... SAFE! Floated and full ball around off, Hafeez jumps out of the crease to play a big shot over long off but fails to connect properly. Stokes runs back from inside the ring, tries to catch the ball with a dive but it falls wide of him. Two runs taken.
Starts with a shortish length ball on off, Babar goes on the back foot and punches it down to long on for a run.
Moeen Ali comes into the attack now.
Floated on the stumps, MH blocks it off his front foot.

NOT OUT! England have lost their only review. Flatter outside leg, Hafeez looks to flick but misses. There was a noise as the ball went behind and Buttler grabs it. They put in an appeal which is turned down. Buttler and Rashid have a chat before they take it upstairs. Replays roll in and the Ultra Edge shows there was no bat involved.
England have taken a review for caught behind. Hafeez is the man in question.
Flighted outside off, Babar strokes it to deep cover and gets a run.

OUTSTANDING EFFORT! Jason Roy has saved FIVE runs for his side but is still disappointed. Will tell you why? A full toss outside off, Hafeez jumps out of the crease and pumps it over mid off. It is destined to go all the way over the rope but Roy in the deep jumps to take the catch over his head. But he realizes that his momentum is making him fall on the rope, hence he releases the ball immediately towards long on. After that he is seen shaking his head as he feels that he could have thrown it on the full to the fielder to his right. Standards are very high these days.
On the pads, Azam tucks it down the leg side for a single.
Full on off, Babar blocks it off the front foot.
Now follows it up with a single down top third man. Smart batting this. 8 off the over.
FOUR! In the slot for Azam. It is full outside off, Babar says thank you very much and smashes his drive past cover for a boundary.
On off, Azam gets onto his back foot and blocks it.
On the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but it goes off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.

On the body, Hafeez tucks it wide of the man at mid-wicket and gets a run. Denly hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. An unnecessary throw there. The ball deflects off the stumps towards fine leg for another run. Two taken overall.
Angles in a length ball on off, Hafeez gets behind the line and pushes it down to mid on.
Single to end the over.  In the air but safe. Tossed up on middle and leg, Hafeez hits it uppishly towards long on. It falls short of the man there and he keeps the strike with a run.
Googly pitching on middle, Hafeez defends it successfully.
This time Babar flicks it past the man there for a run.
On the pads, Azam flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Hafeez flicks it away to the leg side for a run.
Yorks himself there. It is flighted on middle and leg, Hafeez comes down the track and jams it out.
10 runs from the over. Another good one for Pakistan. The last ball is on the pads, Hafeez flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Slower delivery now outside off. Azam follows the boundary with a smart single with a push towards cover.
FOUR! In the air but safe. Short around off, Babar pulls it wide of the diving mid-wicket fielder. The fielder from deep square leg has no chance to stop it and the ball races away to the fence.
On the pads, Hafeez flicks it away to the on side and rotates the strike.
On a length, Babar defends it with soft hands. The ball goes behind and they take a run as Buttler comes and gathers it. Good running this.
Short again this time, Hafeez taps it down to third man and gets a run.
WIDE! Shorter in length but down the leg side, Hafeez looks to pull but misses. Wide signalled.
Single to end the over. It is outside off, Hafeez just nudges it to long on and gets an easy run.
Floated on middle and leg, Hafeez flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Leg spinner outside off, BA strokes it to long on against the spin for a run.
Quicker on the pads, Hafeez comes down the track and flicks it away to the on side for a run.
Flighted on off, Babar pushes it to cover and takes a quick run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Hafeez milks it down to long off for a run.
Well fielded! Saves at least two for his side. Shorter in length and on off, Azam guides it to the left of point. Roy there dives in that direction and stops it. End of a tight over by Stokes.
Slower one again outside off, Hafeez waits for it and then guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Another dot as the slower one is worked towards mid-wicket.
Goes slightly fuller and on off, Hafeez goes back and defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Babar plays it late and down to third man for a single.
On the shorter side and it skids through. Hafeez is a touch late on the pull, it hits his gloves and rolls towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Nice way to finish the over. Floated outside off, Babar picks the length early and smashes it through covers for a boundary. A very good over for Pakistan. 16 runs off it.
Follows it up with a single down towards sweeper cover.
SIX! Hafeez takes the aerial route and gets the desired result. Rashid tosses it up outside off, Hafeez gets on his knees and slog sweeps it against the spin over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Hafeez has played it to the point region.
On the body, BA tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful. Perfect start to the over. Flighted on off, Babar gets on his front foot and drives it wonderfully through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Azam flicks it to square leg and keeps the strike. Tight start from Stokes. Just 2 off his first.
Length ball on off, Azam taps it back to the bowler.
Bouncer on off, Azam pulls it but finds the man at mid-wicket.
On off, Babar defends it to the man at cover.
On the pads, Hafeez glances it down to fine leg and gets to the other end.
Stokes starts with a back of a length delivery outside off, Babar looks to pull but misses and it hits him on the pads. The ball goes towards point and they take a leg bye.
Ben Stokes is introduced into the attack.
Short and wide outside off, MH cuts it but straight to the man at point.
On the body, BA milks it to long on and rotates the strike.
Hafeez is off the mark. Outside off, Hafeez nudges it to deep cover and gets a run.
Once again short on the body this time, Hafeez pushes it to mid off.
Short outside off, Hafeez looks to cut but gets a bottom edge which goes on one bounce to Stokes at first slip.
Rashid tosses it up outside off, Babar strokes it to deep point and gets to the other end.
Time for the Professor to deliver a lecture. Here comes Mohammad Hafeez.

OUT! Caught! Wow. A wicket falls at last. After 119 legal deliveries. A length ball, outside off, Zaman reaches out to hit hard but gets a top edge. The ball flies high in the air and Mark Wood runs in from third man. He keeps his eyes on the ball and dives forward to take the catch. The 107-run stand is broken and Fakhar Zaman walks off after doing all the hard work, for 57.
Another short ball, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
A short ball, around off, Azam pulls it through mid-wicket where Joe Denly dives to his right and dives to stop the ball.
Full and around off, Azam looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and around middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.

Down the leg side, Fakhar paddles this down the leg side. Short third man gets across and returns a throw to the keeper who in turn, fires it to the bowler. He misses, the backup misses as well but luckily for England, Joe Root is backing from mid on. Three runs in the end, which could have been seven.
Pitched outside leg, Fakhar looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Zaman lofts this over mid off and gets a boundary!
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a single.
Proper spin on offer now. Here is Adil Rashid.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a run.

10TH ODI FIFTY FOR ZAMAN! Like Babar, he too, has played a decent knock but needs to go a bit berserk now. England are bossing this middle period. Reaches there with a soft tickle on the leg side for a single.
On middle, pushed through mid on.

FIFTY FOR BABAR! In 49 balls. His 12th in this format. A short ball, around off, Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for a run. Just a simple raise of the bat towards the crowd and the dressing room. Now, for the acceleration.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a couple.

DRINKS BREAK. If you have just checked onto the scorecard, Pakistan's score reads 101/0 but they are technically one down, with Imam-ul-Haq getting injured in the fourth over and gone to the hospital for a precautionary x-ray. He got hit on the left elbow and coach Mickey Arthur had his head in his hands. There is plenty of breeze but barely any movement on this deck. It is a proper highway with no traffic. Feast yourselves. Pakistan are doing well but they are not quite targetting the part-time bowler Denly. His 5 overs have gone for 27 which is a bonus for Jos Buttler.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for another single. 100 UP FOR PAKISTAN. Another decent start for them.
Fullish on middle, pushed through mid on for one more.
Outside off, punched past the bowler towards long on for a run.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Around middle and leg, defended towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That is short and asking for trouble. Pulled over square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, guided towards third man for a single.
WIDE. A bouncer, around middle, Azam ducks out of harm's way.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one more.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Azam comes down the track and lofts it over mid off who is inside the circle. One bounce and into the ropes.
Outside off, played through point for one.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Tossed up around leg, flicked through mid on for a single.
Outside off, Zaman looks to punch but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. A run taken.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a run.

Full and outside off, driven down the ground. Ben Stokes gives it a good chase from mid off, gets to the ball, dives but while returning the ball, he slips and almost loses the ball. He manages to recover but in that process, the batsmen take the third.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, Zaman punches this behind point. Tom Curran gives this a good chase from sweeper cover and gets to the ball, pulling the ball back in. Two runs taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to short cover.
Down the leg side, worked through square leg for a run.
STAT ALERT - England have won 19 out of their last 20 ODIs while chasing. One was a TIE.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Down the leg side once more, flicked towards fine leg for another single.
WIDE. Will have to rebowl that. Full and down the leg side, Azam misses his flick.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for one more.
Full and outside off, driven on the up, but drops short of cover.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a run.
Outside off, pushed wide of mid off for a single.
Outside off, punched back.
Tom Curran into the attack.

Flighted outside off, BA comes down the track and looks to flick but misses. Is hit on the pads and England appeal but the impact was outside off. The ball goes down to short third man and Azam is sent back. He is lucky though. That ball was almost gobbled by Buttler as it deflected off the pads but could not quite collect the ball.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full and just around off, well blocked out. 63/0 in Powerplay 1, though you can add that retired hurt of Imam to the wickets total.
A short ball outside off, Azam looks to play the upper cut but misses.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, run down to third man for a couple.
FOUR! Fine shot! 50-RUN STAND IS UP! Full and outside off, Azam leans and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary!
Around leg, worked wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
FOUR! Too short and punished this time. Outside off, a hint of width, Babar goes back and punches this through point for a boundary!
A touch short, around middle and leg, milked through square leg for one.
Landed around middle, drifting in, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Interesting. Joe Denly to bowl his part-time leggies. This could be the time to tee off for Pakistan.
This is pitched around leg, Babar looks to flick but the ball straightens and goes off the leading edge towards mid off. 15 from the over!
First sign of movement all afternoon. On a length outside off, Azam looks to defend but the ball pitches and moves away off the deck to beat the outside edge.

Close call. FZ pushes this towards mid off and sets off for a quick single. Ben Stokes intercepts to his left from extra cover, picks the ball up and then has an under-arm flick at the bowler's end but misses. Zaman was in though, as per the replays.

FOUR! Bad ball, not punished properly but still Wood gets the treatment. Full and down the leg side, Zaman swings hard, gets it off the inner half of the bat but it speeds past a diving Adil Rashid at short fine leg for a boundary.

FOUR! 'CATCH IT!' is the call but no one is catching that. This is how extra pace can help the batsman. This is around leg and middle, short in length, Fakhar is hurried into the pull and he barely even gets his bat to the ball in time before it comes on quickly. But to his luck, it takes the top edge and goes wide of short fine leg to the fence behind!
The umpires are checking the ball now. It seems to have gone out of shape. Out comes the box of balls.
SIX! You bowl length over here, you disappear. Zaman agrees. This is pitched around middle and leg, Zaman hammers this over mid-wicket and it clears the fence with ease.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around middle and leg, helped wide of mid on for a quick run.
Full and outside off, Azam pushes this wide of mid off and takes a quick single.
Around middle and leg, helped to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Zaman tucks it through square leg and finds the gap and the boundary!
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, watchfully pushed to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Glorious shot. On a length outside off, Azam punches this on the up through the covers!
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SIX! That is a cracking shot! Short and outside off, Babar rises up with the bounce and crashes a cut over backward point! That is not a short boundary at all, so all the credit to Babar.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Fine shot. A short ball outside off, Azam gets on top of the bounce and punches it through point for a boundary.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, left alone.
On a good length outside off, zips in after pitching, Azam looks to defend but misses and is hit on the left thigh.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
A short ball, pulled wide of mid on for a couple.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Babar Azam walks in next.

We might see a real delay here. The physio is out in the middle and Imam is certainly not happy. There are some elbow exercises going on and the southpaw is seemingly in way too much pain. AND IMAM IS WALKING OFF. Sensible call. With the world cup around the corner, it is better taking care of your health.

OUCH! Imam is down in pain. He has thrown his bat and gloves and is in too much woe. A short ball, around off, the southpaw looked to pull but the delivery skidded on after pitching and came on way too quickly. The left-hander was found to be early into the shot and was hit flush on the left elbow.
On a good length around middle, watchfully defended.
Outside off, on a length, Fakhar looks to push it on the up but gets beaten.
A short ball, down the leg side, pulled towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Around middle and off, watchfully defended.
A short ball, around middle and off, the southpaw ducks under it.
On a good length, outside leg, Imam looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Jofra starts to appeal but then bails out.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A length ball, pretty straight, watchfully blocked.

SIX! Off the top edge! How small is this ground? A short ball, around middle and leg, Zaman looks to pull but is beaten for pace and cramped for room. The ball goes off the top edge and over the keeper, clearing the fence behind.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Around middle and leg, worked towards mid-wicket.

Wow. This guy has barely played cricket in the last few months but he has already cranked up 88.5 mph on his very first ball. Full and around off, swinging away, Zaman reaches out to drive but gets a bottom edge towards mid-wicket.
Mark Wood to bowl with the second new ball. So we have sheer pace from both ends to start with.
Full and straight, Imam looks to turn it to the leg side but at the last moment, pushes it towards mid off.
On a good length around middle, watchfully defended.
Another flick, this one is behind square leg and he gets off the mark with a couple.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to square leg.
A bit wider outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, Imam looks to punch through the line but misses.
The players walk out to the middle amidst cloudy skies. Jofra Archer to start off proceedings. Imam-ul-Haq to face the first ball. Fakhar Zaman is his partner...

TEAM NEWS - The home side has made a couple pf changes. Along with Buttler, James Vince, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood and Adil Rashid make their way in. Who miss out? Morgan of course, followed by Chris Woakes, Jonny Bairstow, Liam Plunkett and David Willey. Pakistan have made fewer changes - three in particular - Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik and Mohammad Hasnain come in for Haris Sohail, Shaheen Afridi and Faheem Ashraf.

TOSS - We have a new captain for tonight's game. Eoin Morgan being suspended after found being too slow in the third ODI, is replaced by Jos Buttler. The Somerset-born Lancashire star has won the flip of the coin and ENGLAND WILL CHASE.

A caution for all the bowlers - do not expect anything from this game. ANYTHING. It is as flat as a road and you can get nothing other than runs. Feast yourself, if you are a batsman, pray for luck, if you are a bowler.

350-plus in the second game. Almost chased down. 350-plus in the third game. Comfortably chased down. Sorry state of pitches and bowlers. Now, we approach  a venue where run-fest is a small word. Hello and a warm welcome to  yet another 'death-bed for the bowlers' game - the fourth ODI between England and Pakistan at Trent Bridge, Nottingham.
